org.portico.bindings.jgroups

Class Configuration

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.bindings.jgroups.Configuration

  • public class Configuration
extends Object
    All configuration information is stored in system properties as keys. This class provides statics that can be used to identify the specific keys.

    • Method Detail

      • getLogLevel

        public static final String getLogLevel()
        Returns:
        An unvalidated log level from the RID return as a String. Returns "OFF" if not set.

      • getJoinTimeout

        public static final long getJoinTimeout()
        Returns:
        The jgroups join timeout to use in milliseconds. Defaults to 5000.

      • useDaemonThreads

        public static final boolean useDaemonThreads()
        Returns:
        True if JGroups channels should be set up to use Daemon threads for all processing so that they don't keep systems alive and active when not requied. False otherwise. Default is true.

      • isAuditorEnabled

        public static final boolean isAuditorEnabled()
        Returns:
        True if the Auditor has been turned on in configuration, false otherwise. Default is false.

      • isAuditorSummaryOnly

        public static final boolean isAuditorSummaryOnly()
                                          throws JConfigurationException
        Returns:
        True if the Auditor has been set to "summary-only" mode. This happens when a value of "summary" is set in the RID file. A value of "full" in the RID file will cause this to return false. Any other value will cause a configuration exception to be thrown. NOTE: This is only expected to called if the Auditor is enabled. Without the auditor enabled, this setting should have no effect.
        Throws:
        JConfigurationException - If the provided value is unknown

      • getAuditorDirectionFilters

        public static List<String> getAuditorDirectionFilters()
        Returns:
        A list of all the configured direction filters. If no configuration is provided, list will contain one entry - "all". These will be converted to lower case before being returned.

      • getAuditorMessageFilters

        public static List<String> getAuditorMessageFilters()
        Returns:
        A list of all the configured message filters. If no configuration is provided, list will contain one entry - "all". These will be converted to lower case before being returned.

      • getAuditorFomtypeFilters

        public static List<String> getAuditorFomtypeFilters()
        Returns:
        A list of all the configured fomtype filters. If no configuration is provided, list will contain one entry - "all". These will be converted to lower case before being returned.

      • isWanEnabled

        public static boolean isWanEnabled()
        Returns:
        True if the wan mode has been enabled in the RID, false otherwise

      • getWanRouter

        public static InetSocketAddress getWanRouter()
        Return the parsed, validated IP & Port of the WAN Router configuration property contained in the RID. Throws an exception if the string is not in an appropriate format from one of the following: - 111.111.111.111 - 111.111.111.111:22222 - hostname - hostname:port

      • isWanBundlingEnabled

        public static boolean isWanBundlingEnabled()
        Is bundling turned on? Default to `true()`

      • getWanBundleSize

        public static int getWanBundleSize()
        Return the maximum size a bundle should grow to (bytes) before it is flushed. Default is 64K.

      • getWanBundleTimeout

        public static int getWanBundleTimeout()
        Return the maximum amount of time (millis) the bundler should hold a message for before flushing, regardless of bundled size. Default: 20ms
